synthesis: DEV-2386 repoints both Scout check-in query classes off the zod CDC address chain onto clarity.scout_open_addresses (live 2026-08-18, ~4.5M rows / 1,965 orgs), adds a 45-minute staleness gate to scout:record-check-ins before the concurrency slot, and re-enables the commented schedule. AC-1 is absolute: neither ScoutCheckInMatchQuery nor ScoutCheckInRollupQuery may retain a reference to zod.public_hotlist_address or zod.public_address. Coordinates come from the new table's lng/lat. Preserve the semantic difference (matcher: hotlist_id + Direct-wins argMin; rollup: neither, counts a shared address in both buckets), not the public_address join. CROSS JOIN bbox stays (ORDER BY has no geo prefix; 1.55M vs 1.97M rows on the org 14 slice). Config key is book_freshness_minutes (matches lookback_minutes). Rollup consumer is ClarityScoutDashboardController:254 — signature unchanged, but its feature test seeds the old tables. Schema re-export is platform-side via .claude/commands/chlocal.md from Herd/chlocal, resolved from the main checkout not this worktree.
